description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the application's data tier from Oracle Database to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including its data source, persistence configuration, SQL, and photo binary storage.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC data source and driver with PostgreSQL equivalents, update Spring datasource configuration and the Hibernate dialect, and convert schema definitions and any Oracle-specific repository SQL to PostgreSQL-compatible forms. Migrate photo BLOB storage to PostgreSQL bytea. Configure database authentication to use Managed Identity.
